pp. 103–104: Galswinth, marriage property, the immediate grant of Cahors to Brunhild and the four other cities retained by Guntram for his lifetime.
IX.20, Copy of the Agreement, preamble and clauses on Paris, Clodechild, Childebert’s children, Faileuba, Chlodosind, Galswinth’s cities, the leudes, travel and oaths.

summary.de: Die Schwester Brunichilds erhielt anlässlich ihrer Heirat mit Chilperich Rechte an fünf Städten. Die Verteilung beschäftigte die Familie noch lange nach ihrem Tod.
summary.en: Brunhild’s sister received rights in five cities at her marriage to Chilperic. The family still had to settle their disposition long after she died.
